notes: Save a screenshot as a strong example: tick “Save as a strong example” in the Screenshot bar, or press the button on the “Picture copied” note. Before it is saved you can black out anything, like a name, and add why it’s strong and tags.

The Examples page finds work again by tag or by searching what you wrote. Every card shows its tags, and you can change them from its ⋯ menu. Download as a sheet works for whatever the page is showing.
